channel.title: Houston Public Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Houston Public Media (houstonpublicmedia.org)

item.title: Abbie Kamin emerges as top Democratic candidate for Harris County Attorney, advances to general election
item.description: On the Republican ticket, Jacqueline Lucci Smith — a former judge for Harris County Civil Court at Law No. 2 — ran unopposed, receiving 143,099 votes.

item.title: Montgomery County Judge Mark Keough narrowly holds off challenger in Republican primary
item.description: Keough, who was first elected as county judge in 2019, will now compete in November's general election against Democrat James Graf, who ran unopposed in the Democratic primary.

item.title: Nate Sheets defeats three-term incumbent Sid Miller in GOP primary for Texas agriculture commissioner
item.description: Sheets’ campaign was boosted by major endorsements from Gov. Greg Abbott, Land Commissioner Dawn Buckingham and industry groups like the Texas Farm Bureau.

item.title: Trump endorsement will come soon in Texas’ GOP Senate runoff between Cornyn and Paxton
item.description: The president said Wednesday he will ask the candidate he does not endorse to drop out of the race.

item.title: One election after another: Houston’s 18th Congressional District set for 4th election in less than 7 months
item.description: Congressmen Al Green and Christian Menefee will head to a runoff election in May. It will mark yet another election for a congressional district that’s had a tumultuous two years.

item.title: Two Democratic candidates headed for runoff to claim nomination for Harris County District Clerk’s seat
item.description: The Democratic ticket for the position was crowded with eight candidates vying for the seat -- none of which received more than 20% of the vote in the primary election, according to complete but unofficial results on Wednesday.

item.title: Hello Houston (March 4, 2026)
item.description: Today: We discuss an in-depth article about Harris County Judge Lina Hidalgo, talk with a cast member with the national tour of “The Great Gatsby,” learn about how local non-profit redM is tackling human trafficking, and much more.

item.title: Hello Houston – The Commuter Cut (March 4, 2026)
item.description: For our busy Houston commuters, we have – The Commuter Cut – a special 40-minute version of our show to listen to during your journey home.

item.title: Educator Samantha Morris defeats longtime incumbent John Kinard in Galveston County District Clerk primary
item.description: Morris took away about 53% of the early votes, whereas Kinard took away about 47%. Kinard has served in the role since 2012, when he won a special election to take over the position.

item.title: Trump-backed Jon Bonck and Shelly deZevallos headed to runoff in GOP primary for TX-38
item.description: Melissa McDonough won the Democratic nomination in the Houston-area congressional district, a Republican stronghold that has been represented by U.S. Rep. Wesley Hunt.
